extDescription.message: One-click copy, full-width pages, bigger dropdowns, and a colour per environment so you never post in production by mistake.
extDescription.description: The description in the store listing. Hard limit of 132 characters, per language: a longer one is rejected at upload.

optionsTitle.description: Title of the options page. BC Buddy is a product name and stays as it is.

languageTitle.message: The language of BC Buddy. Business Central keeps its own.

saveFailed.description: Shown when the settings could not be stored. $1 is the error message from the browser.

testUrlIntro.message: Drives the previews of the rules and styles below.
testUrlIntro.description: One line under the Test URL heading.

testUrlLabel.message: URL of a Business Central page

useOpenTabTitle.message: Takes the URL from an open tab, preferring a Business Central tab
useOpenTabTitle.description: Tooltip on the button next to the test URL.

noUsableTab.message: No open tab with a usable URL found.

labelEnvironment.description: Business Central term for the environment a tenant runs (production, sandbox). Use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language, not a literal translation.

labelCompany.description: Business Central term for a company inside an environment. Use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

labelTenant.description: Business Central term for the tenant the environment belongs to. Use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

rulesIntro.message: Which environment gets which colour. The first matching rule wins.

emptyRules.description: $1 is the Add rule link (addRule), $2 the import link (emptyRulesImport).

emptyRulesSamples.description: $1 is the Add rule link (addRule), $2 the Load samples link (loadSamples), $3 the import link (emptyRulesImport).

emptyRulesImport.description: Link text inside emptyRules and emptyRulesSamples; opens the file picker for an import.

loadSamplesTitle.message: Add ready-made rules for Master Data, Production, UAT and Development, and the styles Full and Subtle. Rules and styles you already have stay as they are.

samplesAdded.message: $1 sample rule(s) added. Change them like any rule of your own.

samplesStylesAdded.message: $1 sample style(s) added. Pick one on a rule to use it.
samplesStylesAdded.description: $1 is a number of styles. Shown when the sample rules were already there and only their styles were missing.

samplesNone.message: The sample rules and styles are already there.

sharedIntro.message: One file over HTTPS gives the whole team the same rules.
sharedIntro.description: One line under the Shared configuration heading. HTTPS is a name and stays as it is.

syncFailed.description: $1 is the reason the download failed.

syncLoaded.description: $1 is a number of rules. The (s) is an English shortcut for the plural; use whatever the language really needs.

syncLoadedUnchanged.description: $1 is a number of rules. Unchanged means the file was the same as the last time it was fetched.

copiedToOwn.message: Copied $1 rule(s) to your own rules.
copiedToOwn.description: $1 is a number of rules copied out of the shared configuration into the user's own list.

hostedManaged.description: Under the shared file URL when IT set it by browser policy; the field cannot be changed.

statusSyncError.description: $1 is a date and time, $2 the error message.

statusHosted.description: $1 is a number of rules, $2 a date.

statusHostedNamed.description: $1 is a number of rules, $2 the name the shared file gives itself, $3 a date.

importExportIntro.message: Move your own rules, styles and Web client settings in one file.

importNote.message: Import adds new rules and overwrites the ones you already have; rules that are not in the file stay. Web client settings in the file replace yours. The shared configuration is not touched.
importNote.description: Note under the Import and Export buttons in the Settings panel.

importFailed.description: $1 is the reason the import failed.

importDone.description: $1 is a number of rules, $2 the file name, $3 a summary put together from importOverwritten, importAdded and importKept.

importOverwritten.description: $1 is a number of rules. Ends up inside importDone, so it stays a fragment: no capital, no full stop.

importAdded.description: $1 is a number of rules. Ends up inside importDone, so it stays a fragment: no capital, no full stop.

importKept.description: $1 is a number of rules. Ends up inside importDone, so it stays a fragment: no capital, no full stop.

importNone.description: Stands in for the summary in importDone when the file changed nothing.

exportDone.description: $1 is a number of rules. bc-buddy.json is a file name and stays as it is.

ruleNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the name field of a rule. TEST is an example of what somebody might call an environment.

toggleOrDrag.message: Click to show or hide details, drag to reorder

deleteConfirm.description: Asked before a rule is deleted. $1 is the name the user gave it.

matchYes.description: Read out by a screen reader on the rule that wins for the test URL filled in above.

copySuffix.description: Name of a duplicated rule or style. $1 is the name of the original.

previewPageBc.description: Caption on the mock Business Central page in the preview.

previewTitle.description: The name of a real Business Central page, shown on the mock page in the preview. Use the name that page has in this language.

conditionRepeated.message: This condition is already in the rule above, so it adds nothing.

conditionValuePlaceholder.message: e.g. Sandbox, CRONUS BE or a full URL
conditionValuePlaceholder.description: Examples of what a condition can look for. Sandbox is a Business Central term; CRONUS BE is the name of Microsoft's demo company and stays as it is.

conditionMatches.description: Choice in a condition: the rule applies when the condition is true.

conditionNoMatch.description: Choice in a condition: the rule applies when the condition is false.

regexInvalid.message: This RegEx is not valid, so the condition never matches.
regexInvalid.description: Shown on a condition whose regular expression has a syntax error.

regexTooHeavy.message: This RegEx is too complex to check safely on this URL, so the condition does not match. Start it with ^, or use fewer *, + and ?.
regexTooHeavy.description: Shown on a condition whose regular expression could freeze the page. ^, *, + and ? are RegEx symbols and stay as they are.

fieldUrl.description: Part of the address a condition looks at. Stays URL in most languages.

fieldEnvironment.description: Business Central term for the environment a tenant runs (production, sandbox). Use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

fieldCompany.description: Business Central term for a company inside an environment. Use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

fieldTenant.description: Business Central term for the tenant the environment belongs to. Use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

opContains.description: Operator in a condition, read as one line: environment contains TEST. The value may also be a comma-separated list: environment contains DEV, UAT, QA. Lowercase on purpose, it sits in the middle of that line.

opEquals.description: Operator in a condition, read as one line: environment equals TEST. Lowercase on purpose, it sits in the middle of that line.

opStartsWith.description: Operator in a condition, read as one line: environment starts with TEST. Lowercase on purpose, it sits in the middle of that line.

opEndsWith.description: Operator in a condition, read as one line: environment ends with TEST. Lowercase on purpose, it sits in the middle of that line.

opRegex.description: Operator in a condition: match on a regular expression. Usually stays RegEx.

opNotContains.description: Operator in a condition, read as one line: environment does not contain TEST. The value may also be a comma-separated list: environment does not contain PROD, LIVE. Lowercase on purpose, it sits in the middle of that line.

textAuto.description: Choice for the text colour: the extension picks black or white itself, whichever reads better on the chosen colour.

ribbonToggle.description: Switch for colouring the bar at the very top of the Business Central client (the one with the product name). This is NOT the Office ribbon toolbar: do not use that term.

ribbonText.description: The text printed on the diagonal corner strip, see ribbonToggle.

ribbonHint.message: BC's top bar in the rule's colour
ribbonHint.description: Tooltip on Ribbon on a style. BC is short for Business Central and stays as it is.

borderHint.message: A coloured border around the window
borderHint.description: Tooltip on Frame on a style.

bannerHint.message: A bar or corner ribbon with text
bannerHint.description: Tooltip on Banner on a style: a bar along the bottom, or a diagonal strip across a corner.

titleHint.description: Tooltip on Tab title on a style.

faviconHint.description: Tooltip on Replace the favicon on a style.

borderToggle.description: Switch for a coloured border drawn around the whole page.

borderWidth.description: Caption of a slider for the thickness of that border.

bannerToggle.description: Switch for a coloured bar with text along an edge of the page.

posBottom.description: Position of the banner: a full-width bar along the bottom of the page.

posTopRight.description: Position of the banner: a diagonal strip across the top right corner. Ribbon here means that strip, not a toolbar.

posTopLeft.description: Position of the banner: a diagonal strip across the top left corner. Ribbon here means that strip, not a toolbar.

posBottomRight.description: Position of the banner: a diagonal strip across the bottom right corner. Ribbon here means that strip, not a toolbar.

posBottomLeft.description: Position of the banner: a diagonal strip across the bottom left corner. Ribbon here means that strip, not a toolbar.

bannerText.description: The text on the banner, see bannerToggle.

bannerFontSize.description: Caption of a slider for the size of the banner text.

bannerFontSizeHint.message: Text size. All the way left the text shrinks until it fits; further right it is larger and fixed.
bannerFontSizeHint.description: Tooltip on the banner Size slider.

titleToggle.description: Switch for replacing the title of the browser tab. The tab, not the Business Central page.

titleText.description: What the browser tab is called once titleToggle is on.

faviconToggle.description: Switch for replacing the small icon on the browser tab. Favicon is the usual word in most languages.

faviconLetters.description: The one or two letters drawn on that tab icon.

faviconLettersHint.message: The one or two letters on the coloured icon in the browser tab, so you can tell this environment apart among your tabs. Left empty, the icon shows the first two letters of the rule name.

tokenName.description: Explains the {name} token. A token here is a placeholder the user types into a text, such as {name}, and the extension fills in; nothing to do with a security token. Lowercase: it is read after the token itself.

tokenEnvironment.description: Explains the {environment} token, see tokenName. Lowercase: it is read after the token itself.

tokenCompany.description: Explains the {company} token, see tokenName. Lowercase: it is read after the token itself.

tokenTitle.description: Explains the {title} token, see tokenName. Lowercase: it is read after the token itself.

tokensFooter.message: A token that stays empty disappears together with the separator next to it.
tokensFooter.description: Closing line under the list of tokens.

errHttpsOnly.message: The shared file must be served over HTTPS.
errHttpsOnly.description: HTTPS is a protocol name and stays as it is.

errHttp.description: $1 is an HTTP status code, $2 the status text that came with it.

clearSharedConfirm.message: Remove the $1 shared rules and switch the shared configuration off? The URL stays, so one click on Synchronise brings them back.
clearSharedConfirm.description: $1 is a number of rules. Synchronise is the button labelled syncNow: use the same wording.

errTimeout.message: The shared file did not respond within $1 seconds.

errTooLarge.message: The shared file is too large (limit $1 kB).

errInvalidJson.description: $1 is the error from the parser. JSON is a format name and stays as it is.

errNoRules.description: The word rules between quotes is a key in the file itself and stays in English.

errOtherApp.message: This file belongs to another application ($1).
errOtherApp.description: $1 is the name of the application the file says it belongs to.

importStyles.description: Appended to importDone, which is why it starts with a space. $1 is a number of styles, see stylesHeading.

importWebClient.description: Appended to importDone, which is why it starts with a space. $1 is how many switches or sliders on the Web client panel (see webClientHeading) the file changed.

emptyStyles.message: No styles yet. Add one to reuse the same appearance across several rules.

stylesIntro.message: What a marker looks like: ribbon, frame, banner, tab title and favicon.
stylesIntro.description: Explains what a style holds, see stylesHeading.

deleteStyleConfirm.message: Delete style "$1"? $2 rule(s) will fall back to their own settings.
deleteStyleConfirm.description: $1 is the name of the style, $2 a number of rules that were using it.

stylesHeading.description: A style here is this extension's own idea: a saved set of appearance settings that several rules can share. It is not a Business Central report layout, nor the style Business Central gives a field (such as Favorable or Unfavorable).

newStyleName.description: The name a freshly added style gets, see stylesHeading.

copiedStyles.description: Appended to copiedToOwn, which is why it starts with a space. $1 is a number of styles.

styleLabel.description: Label on the field that picks a style for a rule, see stylesHeading.

styleNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the name field of a style. Default is an example of what somebody might call one.

navWebClient.description: Navigation item leading to the panel with tweaks to the Business Central web client itself (maximize, dropdown size, current line). Use the term the Business Central documentation uses for the web client in this language.

maximizeIntro.message: Automatically expands every Business Central page to wide layout and switches tile pages to list view. A page you set back yourself stays that way.
maximizeIntro.description: Explains what the maximize feature does. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel.

maximizeToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch for the maximize feature.

pinActionBarIntro.message: Pins the action bar under a page's tabs the first time the page opens. Unpin it on a page and that page stays unpinned.
pinActionBarIntro.description: Explains the pin action bar feature. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. 'Action bar' and 'pin' are the terms Business Central itself uses for the row of actions and its pin button.

pinActionBarToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch for the pin action bar feature. Use Business Central's own wording for its 'Pin action bar' button in this language.

hideFactBoxIntro.message: Closes the FactBox pane on the right on pages you open for the first time. Open it again on a page and it stays open there.
hideFactBoxIntro.description: Explains the hide FactBox pane switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. FactBox is the Business Central term for the pane on the right: use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

hideFactBoxToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that closes the FactBox pane on pages where nobody opened or closed it yet. Use Business Central's own word for the FactBox pane in this language.

dropdownHeading.description: Heading of the setting that gives the list opening under a lookup field (the dropdown) more room.

dropdownIntro.message: Gives the list that opens under a field more room. The width follows the columns, up to the maximum set here.
dropdownIntro.description: Explains the dropdown size sliders. Tooltip on their row in the Web client panel. BC is short for Business Central and stays as it is.

highlightRowToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that tints the line you are on in editable lists. Line is the Business Central term for a row on a document or journal (sales line, journal line).

highlightRowIntro.message: Gives the line you are on a light tint in editable lists, such as sales lines and journals.
highlightRowIntro.description: Explains the current line highlight. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. Sales lines and journals are Business Central terms: use the words the Business Central UI uses in this language.

stripeRowsToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that gives every other row in a list a light grey, so the eye stays on the right line.

stripeRowsIntro.message: Gives every other row in a list a light grey, so you stay on the right line in a wide list.
stripeRowsIntro.description: Explains striped rows. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel.

noAnimationsToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that makes Business Central pages, FastTabs and panes appear at once instead of sliding or fading in.

noAnimationsIntro.message: Pages, dialogs, FastTabs and panes appear at once instead of sliding or fading in. Progress indicators keep moving.
noAnimationsIntro.description: Explains the turn off animations switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. FastTab is the Business Central term for a collapsible section on a page: use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

resizePanesToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that lets you drag the left edge of the Help, Copilot, Page Inspection and Personalization panes in Business Central to make them wider or narrower.

resizePanesIntro.message: Drag the left edge of Help, Copilot, Page Inspection or the Personalization field list to make it wider or narrower. Double-click the edge for the standard width again. The width is remembered.
resizePanesIntro.description: Explains the resize panes switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. Help, Copilot, Page Inspection and Personalization are Business Central names: use the words the Business Central UI uses in this language.

copyValuesToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that shows a copy icon on read-only values in Business Central lists, FactBoxes and the Page Inspection pane, and on read-only links on cards.

copyValuesIntro.message: Rest the mouse on a value in a list or a FactBox, or on a link on a card, and click the icon to copy it, as shown.
copyValuesIntro.description: Explains the copy values switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. FactBox is the Business Central term for the pane on the right: use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

copyValue.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the copy icon shown on a value in Business Central.

copiedValue.description: Tooltip of the copy icon right after the value was copied.

weekNumbersToggle.message: Week numbers in the date picker
weekNumbersToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that shows the week number in front of each week in the Business Central date picker (the calendar that opens from a date field).

weekNumbersIntro.message: Turns on Business Central's own week numbers in the calendar of a date field. Press Shift+Home in the calendar to turn them off or on again; Business Central remembers it.
weekNumbersIntro.description: Explains the week numbers switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel.

hideNotificationsToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that hides the bell icon in the Business Central top bar. Notifications is what Business Central calls the pane that bell opens: use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

hideNotificationsIntro.message: Hides the bell at the top right of Business Central that opens Notifications.
hideNotificationsIntro.description: Explains the hide notifications switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel. Notifications is the Business Central pane the bell opens: use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

dropdownWidth.description: Label beside the slider that sets the maximum width of a dropdown.

dropdownHeight.description: Label beside the slider that sets the maximum height of a dropdown.

webClientMore.description: Link under the Web client settings to the documentation page that explains them.

resetWebClientTitle.message: Puts the Web client settings back to how BC Buddy starts out.

resetWebClientTeam.description: Same button as resetWebClient, when a shared file sets Web client settings.

resetWebClientTeamTitle.message: Puts the Web client settings back to what your team's shared file says, and the rest to how BC Buddy starts out.

resetWebClientDone.description: $1 is a number of settings. Followed by an Undo link.

resetWebClientNone.message: These settings are already at their defaults.

resetWebClientUndone.message: Your settings are back as they were.

environmentsMore.description: Link under the Environments panel to the documentation page that explains rules and styles.

dropdownStandard.description: Shown beside a dropdown size slider at its lowest step, where Business Central keeps its own size. BC is short for Business Central and stays as it is.

navEnvironments.description: Navigation item leading to the rules, one per Business Central environment.

navHelp.description: Last item in the options page navigation. It opens the BC Buddy documentation website in a new tab.

shortcutsToggle.description: Label on the on/off switch that adds a keyboard icon to the top bar of Business Central, which shows the keyboard shortcuts.

shortcutsIntro.message: Adds a keyboard icon to the top bar of Business Central. It shows the keyboard shortcuts that work where you are, and the ones of the page itself.
shortcutsIntro.description: Explains the keyboard shortcuts switch. Tooltip on its row in the Web client panel.

commandShortcuts.message: Show the keyboard shortcuts for this Business Central page
commandShortcuts.description: Name of the browser keyboard shortcut people can set for the panel, shown on the browser page where extension shortcuts are set.

scIconLabel.description: Tooltip of the keyboard icon BC Buddy adds to the top bar of Business Central.

scTitle.description: Heading of the keyboard shortcuts panel. Buddy stays in English in every language.

scClose.description: Tooltip of the close button of the keyboard shortcuts panel.

scPage.description: Heading above the actions of the current Business Central page that have a shortcut, read from the page.

scLines.description: Heading above the shortcuts for editable lines: journal lines or the lines of a sales order. Lines is the Business Central term.

scList.description: Heading above the shortcuts for a Business Central list.

scCard.description: Heading above the shortcuts for a Business Central card or document page. Card is the Business Central term.

scDate.description: Heading above the shortcuts that fill in a date field.

scAnywhere.description: Heading above the shortcuts that work on every Business Central page.

scCopyAbove.message: Copy the value from the line above
scCopyAbove.description: What F8 does in editable lines.

scOpenList.message: Open the dropdown list or look up a value
scOpenList.description: What Alt+Down does: opens the dropdown or lookup of a field.

scSearch.description: What F3 does in a list.

scFilterValue.message: Filter to this value, or clear that filter
scFilterValue.description: What Alt+F3 does in a list.

scFilterPane.message: Open or close the filter pane
scFilterPane.description: What Shift+F3 does in a list.

scResetFilters.description: What Ctrl+Shift+Alt+F3 does in a list.

scSort.description: What Alt+F7 does in a list.

scCopyRows.message: Select and copy all rows, for Excel
scCopyRows.description: What Ctrl+A followed by Ctrl+C does in a list.

scFirstLast.message: Go to the first or last row
scFirstLast.description: What Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End do in a list.

scFastTabs.description: What F6 and Shift+F6 do on a card. FastTab is the Business Central term: use the word the Business Central UI uses in this language.

scFoldFastTab.description: What Alt+F6 does on a card.

scNextRecord.description: What Ctrl+Down and Ctrl+Up do on a card.

scSaveClose.description: What Ctrl+Enter does on a card.

scNewWindow.description: What Alt+Shift+W does on a card.

scToday.description: What typing t does in a date field.

scWorkDate.description: What typing w does in a date field. Work date is the Business Central term.

scCalendar.description: What Alt+Down does in a date field.

scTellMe.message: Tell me: find a page or report
scTellMe.description: What Alt+Q does. Tell me is the name of the Business Central search: use the name the Business Central UI uses in this language.

scFactBox.message: Show or hide the FactBox pane
scFactBox.description: What Alt+F2 does. FactBox is the Business Central term.

scRefresh.description: What F5 does in Business Central.

scKeyTips.message: Show access keys for the actions
scKeyTips.description: What pressing Alt alone does: Business Central shows a letter on each action. Access keys is the Business Central term.

scNotListed.message: Actions in menus you have not opened yet are not listed.
scNotListed.description: Note at the bottom of the shortcuts panel.

scDocsAll.description: Link to Microsoft's article with every Business Central keyboard shortcut.

gearMenuSettings.description: Link under the BC Buddy heading in Business Central's gear menu (Settings pane). Opens the options page.

defaultStyleName.description: The name of the style that is there from the start. A name somebody sees in a list, not the word standard as a setting.

fullStyleName.description: Name of a ready-made style that shows every marking: bar at the top, frame, banner, tab title and tab icon. A name in a list, given once when the style is added; renaming it later is up to the user.

subtleStyleName.description: Name of a ready-made style that only colours the bar at the top: a quiet marking, the opposite of fullStyleName. A name in a list, given once when the style is added.

lastStyle.message: The last style cannot be removed: there must always be one.
lastStyle.description: Shown when somebody tries to delete the only style left.

clearShared.message: Clear shared rules and stop updating
clearShared.description: Button that throws away the shared rules and stops the daily update.

sharedCleared.message: Shared rules cleared. They are no longer updated.

copyShared.message: Make your own copy of this rule
copyShared.description: Turns a shared rule into a copy the user owns and can edit.
